tools.name: find_categories
tools.description:
Find category ids to use with search_places / export_leads. Returns matching ids, their place
        in the taxonomy, and how many US places each has. Broader ids include all their subcategories.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description:
Search US businesses and places by category, name and location. Needs at least one location
        filter or a name. Returns up to 100 compact results per call plus the total match count; use
        export_leads instead when you need more than a few pages.

tools.name: get_place
tools.description:
Full record for one place: all contact fields, coordinates, category path, data sources and
        license, and the latest website check if one was run.

tools.name: export_leads
tools.description:
Build a lead list as a CSV download link (valid 24 h): name, category, address, phone, website,
        email, socials, coordinates, source and license per row. Needs a category and a location.
        Rows count against the plan's monthly export quota; preview shows the first rows.

tools.name: verify_websites
tools.description:
Check whether each place's listed website is live right now (status per place: live,
        live_bot_protected, redirected_elsewhere, page_not_found, dead_domain, unreachable, ...).
        Use before outreach. Each place checked counts as one call.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: export_leads · Private data: get_place · Public sink: export_leads · Destructive: get_place.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: export_leads · Private data: get_place · Public sink: export_leads · Destructive: get_place

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
